t: Vigil. The course of whoever stays

b.x: 1. Whoever stays writes at the hour, not at night, from memory. Memory lies. The paper, or this screen, does not.
2. The glucose is the number the meter showed. It is not the number the house found fair. Write it with the hour. Do not change the medicine because of one line. The sugar plan belongs to the doctor.

3. The pressure is the two numbers from the device, the high one and the low one, with the person quiet and the arm supported, if the nurse already taught it that way. One number alone does not decide the afternoon. A written series decides the talk with whoever cares.
4. The rest fits on the same line: temperature, whether they ate, whether they drank, whether it hurt, whether the skin changed, and one short sentence. No romance. No diagnosis.

5. The agenda is the sentence you want to hear. Write “It is time to take Maria to the doctor”. At the saved hour, the clock says that. With no date, it repeats every day. With a date, it speaks on that day. Leave this page open. If the browser is force-closed, the call can fail.

6. A note is not rescue. If the person does not wake as usual, if the breathing falls, if speech muddles all at once, if one side of the body does not obey, the step is 192. This screen does not dial. It does not invent a dose. It does not make a nurse.
A face that falls, an arm that does not rise, speech that muddles, all at once. Do not wait to see if it passes. The step is 192.
They do not wake as usual, or they wake confused in a new way. Breath that costs, a blue lip, a sentence that does not finish. The step is 192.
Chest pain, a squeeze, pain that goes down the arm or up to the jaw, cold sweat. The step is 192. Do not offer a medicine the house invented.

Low sugar has a face: sweat, tremor, hunger, confusion. If they still swallow and the doctor already taught the house to give sugar, follow that plan. If they do not swallow or do not wake, do not put liquid into a closed mouth. The step is 192.

High sugar, over the hours: thirst, a lot of urine, vomiting, sweet breath, sleepiness. Write the number from the meter. If they do not wake or the breathing goes off, the step is 192. Do not invent insulin.

One high pressure number, on a quiet afternoon, is a line for the doctor. Chest pain, shortness of breath, a sudden headache with confusion, or one side that fails, is not a line. It is 192. The number the doctor already gave this person is worth more than any number from a page.
Write what the device showed. It stays on this phone.
Write the sentence. At the hour, the clock speaks that sentence.
